name: omniroute-desktop-spike
description: THROWAWAY feasibility spike — does the standalone Next server boot inside Electron on Windows? Delete this folder once it has answered.
_comment_no_rebuild: There is deliberately no `rebuild` script. better-sqlite3 13.0.3 is a Node-API addon (package.json: gypfile false, no `bindings`, no `prebuild-install`, no install script) and ships one runtime-agnostic binary per platform in prebuilds/. Node-API is ABI-stable across Node AND Electron, so there is nothing to rebuild. @electron/rebuild 3.7.2 misdetects this: its prebuildify check expects prebuilds/win32-x64/ as a DIRECTORY, v13 ships prebuilds/win32-x64.node as a FILE, so all three of its prebuilt-module detectors miss and it falls through to compiling from source — which is the only reason it demanded Visual Studio and a Windows SDK.
